positions.title: Product Architect
description: I began at Novo Nordisk as a developer working with UI5, CAP, and SAP BTP on a digital certificate solution. By combining continuous self-improvement with a strong focus on delivery, I developed a practical understanding of the organisation's complex ERP systems and their integrations.

As I progressed into a senior developer role, I took on broader technical ownership and became increasingly involved in solution design, integration decisions, and the quality of delivery across the product lifecycle.

In my current role as Product Architect, I serve as the primary architectural owner for the Digital Certificate Solution, guiding its evolution across SAP BTP, CAP, UI5, Novo Nordisk ERP systems, and supporting enterprise services. I established a modular architecture vision in which CAP services act as the central orchestration layer for integrations and business logic.

I shape the architectural direction of roadmap initiatives such as master data administration, certificate generation pipelines, and dataset expansions. I represent the architectural runway during PI planning, balancing business features with technical debt reduction, security improvements, UI5 modernization, and GxP governance.

I am also pioneering Model Context Protocol adoption within the SAP landscape by exposing enterprise CAP APIs as AI-consumable tools for agentic workflows. I design practical prototypes, including certificate retrieval assistants and automated workflow triggers, and share this work through internal talks on MCP architecture and tool-based reasoning.

Alongside architecture leadership, I manage release activities, pipeline governance, security hardening, vulnerability remediation, application log reviews, and environment readiness across TEST and PROD. I coordinate with Product Owners, developers, SAP Basis, and business stakeholders, while mentoring developers on CAP, OData, UI5, testing strategies, and maintainable software design.

positions.title: Full-stack software developer
description: Full-stack software developer working across the entire development lifecycle—from SQL database design and backend logic in .NET/C# to building dynamic front-end interfaces using Angular and TypeScript. I also applied HTML and CSS to craft responsive, user-friendly designs.
As part of a Scrum team practicing Agile methodology, I’ve contributed to some of the most critical features in the company’s core PIM solution, driving both functionality and visual improvements.

positions.title: Software developer
description: I was a member of a Scrum team that implemented from the ground up a comprehensive software solution for antimicrobial stewardship.

During my time at Treat Systems, I worked with antimicrobial stewardship data collection and manipulation, within an environment where requirements precision and error toleration were extremely strict.

positions.title: Software developer
description: I worked on two major projects:
Network Operation Center Email Collector (NOC): An application that collects data from mobile operators, stores it and displays it in responsive graphs, to detect data anomalies or misbehavior.

Manual and Automated Testing Strategy:  A fully documented test strategy for the above-mentioned application(NOC), and the company main product 'OSS Suite 2solve', which included unit tests, integration tests and automated GUI tests.

The projects were highly complex, involving multiple third-party systems and APIs, and required a deep understanding of networking concepts and protocols. I worked with technologies such as Java, Spring Boot and various testing frameworks.

positions.title: Software developer
description: I worked on a social-betting platform for casual and dedicated bettors, where I implemented social and betting features, using .NET/C# and SQL Server as backend technologies, and Angular and TypeScript for the front-end.
